what: QED active security checks against an isolated scratch copy
target: http://127.0.0.1:5198 on a scratch database (deleted with the temporary directory by the operating system)

checks.name: every owner route refuses a request with no session
checks.asvs: V8.2 authorization at a trusted layer

checks.name: every state-changing route refuses a request with no session
the public session route gives nothing about any owner when signed out
checks.expected: authenticated false and no user, csrf or sessions

checks.name: a state change with the cookie but no CSRF token is refused
another owner's CSRF token does not work with this owner's cookie
a request carrying a foreign Origin is refused even with a valid cookie and token
a cross-site read is refused (Sec-Fetch-Site)
a request for any other Host is refused (DNS rebinding)
sign-in without the interface's own header is refused (plain form post)
none of the refused requests changed anything
the session cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and scoped to the site
the session token is never returned in a response body
the database stores only a hash of the session token
checks.expected: no row keyed by the raw token
checks.observed: 0 rows keyed by the raw token

checks.name: every response carries a restrictive Content-Security-Policy
checks.observed: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base

checks.name: nosniff, no framing, no referrer, no caching of API replies
an owner cannot read, confirm, use or change another owner's instruction, approval, bill or payee
checks.observed: read the instruction: 404 not_found; read the approval: 404 not_found; confirm the approval: 404 not_found; cancel the approval: 404 not_found; use the approval: 404 not_found; request signing of the instruction: 404 not_found; revoke the instruction: 404 not_found; discard the draft: 404 not_found; remove the bill: 409 bill_not_due; pay with the victim's payee: 400 invalid

checks.name: after those attempts the victim's approval, bill and draft are unchanged
checks.expected: approval open, bill due, draft present

checks.name: an owner cannot read, cancel or dispute another owner's payment
checks.observed: 200 confirm by the victim; read the action: 404 not_found; cancel the action: 404 not_found; dispute the payment: 404 not_found

checks.name: an owner cannot read another owner's receipt
the attacker's ledger, activity and receipts contain nothing of the victim's
a used approval cannot be used again
confirming with a different document fingerprint is refused
checks.asvs: V2.3: approval bound to exact content

checks.name: an approval that was never confirmed cannot be used
25 simultaneous uses of one approval create exactly one payment
checks.observed: 1 action(s); 25 of 25 requests answered 200 (all returning the same action)

checks.name: what runs is built from the approved document: parameters sent with the request are ignored
an approval for one instruction cannot put another in force
a draft changed after it was signed cannot be put in force with the old signature
checks.asvs: V2.3: approval bound to exact content

checks.name: guessing the signing password is cut off after eight wrong tries, and then even the right one waits
checks.expected: 8 rejected, then 429 including for the right password
checks.observed: 8 rejected, 2 limited, right password afterwards: 429 too_many

checks.name: a body over 64 KB is refused
a form-encoded body is refused: JSON only
malformed JSON is refused without a server error
a JSON body that is not an object is refused
an amount that is not a positive whole number of paise within range is refused
SQL and path metacharacters in ids and query values cause no server error and reveal nothing
checks.expected: no 500; users table intact; no stored password hash in any reply
checks.observed: statuses 404,200; 2 users; 2 stored hashes searched for

checks.name: markup in a name is stored as text and served as JSON that a browser will not sniff as HTML
checks.expected: application/json with nosniff; the interface renders text nodes only

checks.name: prototype-pollution keys in a body do not pollute anything
checks.expected: no polluted property on a fresh object

checks.name: no path leaves the built interface's folder
checks.expected: none of 9 traversal paths returns a file from outside it

checks.name: the static side accepts only GET and HEAD
short, common and handle-derived passwords are refused at registration
a wrong password and an unknown handle get the same answer, and both cost a password hash
checks.expected: same status and message; both take the time of a hash
checks.observed: 401 bad_credentials "That handle and password do not match." in 581 ms; 401 bad_credentials "That handle and password do not match." in 305 ms

checks.name: after repeated wrong passwords the account is locked, and the right password does not open it until the lock ends
checks.expected: locked: the right password is refused
checks.observed: 4 of 5 further guesses rejected; right password then: 429 locked

checks.name: after signing out, the old cookie is worthless
one owner cannot hold more than six live connections
asking the bank reserve to withstand less needs the password again; asking it to withstand more does not
checks.expected: 401 stepup_required, then 200 for the stronger setting, then 200 once the password is entered

checks.name: lowering the everyday spending figure lowers what must stay in the bank, so it needs the password; raising it does not
checks.expected: 401 stepup_required naming both figures; 200 for the higher figure
checks.observed: 401 stepup_required "This lowers what must stay in your bank account from ₹1,69,215.33 to ₹60,000, which frees "; 200

checks.name: lowering the floor needs the password; raising it does not
removing a bill that is counted in what must stay needs the password
checks.expected: 401 stepup_required, then 200 once the password is entered
checks.observed: added 200, 200; remove 401 stepup_required; with the password 200

checks.name: anyone with the session can stop everything; undoing the stop, and signing out everywhere, need the password
checks.expected: 200 to stop; 401 stepup_required to undo it and to sign out everywhere
checks.observed: stop 200; undo 401 stepup_required; sign out everywhere 401 stepup_required

checks.name: without the password a session cannot approve ₹10,000 in a day by splitting it: two payments of ₹6,000 prepared together, the second is refused at confirmation
checks.expected: neither asks for the password when prepared; the first confirms; the second answers 401 stepup_required; a third says it needs the password
checks.observed: prepared 200 false, 200 false; confirm 200, 401 stepup_required; third requires the password: true

checks.name: reserve assumptions outside their range are refused with a message per field
the absence summary clamps its time to the life of the account and never reaches another owner
checks.expected: 200 with nothing done for a new account, whatever time is asked for

checks.name: a nested route of the built interface serves the page with absolute asset paths, and a missing file is 404, not the page
checks.expected: the page with /assets/ paths; 404 for the missing file

checks.name: after every attack the ledger still balances and the rail holds one payment for each action
checks.expected: no unbalanced entry; payments on the rail equal actions sent
checks.observed: 0 unbalanced entries; 2 rail payments for 2 actions

checks.name: no request produced an unhandled server error
checks.expected: nothing on the services' error output
